verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox is built to run agent-generated code in isolated Linux microVMs "without exposing your production systems." Its docs explicitly support testing in isolation, with logs, file edits, live previews and dev servers, through both the SDK and a CLI aimed at manual testing and agentic workflows. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation, and no documented controls (e.g., network egress restrictions or test-data seeding) that would guarantee sandboxed code cannot reach production data.
